title: N-Queens
goal: Solve N-Queens: Place one queen per row while excluding occupied columns and diagonals, undoing each placement before trying another.
strategy: Place one queen per row while excluding occupied columns and diagonals, undoing each placement before trying another.
edgeCases: A row with no legal column ends that branch; some board sizes have no solutions.

checks.condition: col in cols or (row-col) in diag1 or (row+col) in diag2
